kinds.d: Device that fires wired darts to deliver an incapacitating electric shock; Taser is the best-known brand.
Hand-held device that delivers an electric shock through electrodes pressed against the body.
Launcher that fires frangible projectiles filled with an irritant powder.
Rigid or telescoping club made for striking.
Short rod held in the fist to strike or apply pressure.
Walking stick whose shaft hides a sword blade drawn from it. A cane without a blade is in Bags & Accessories or Health, Medical & Mobility.

notes: All seven kinds kept. Pepper spray: formula (spray/gel) as types; old kind had no source and none was added (no web research on this shelf). Taser-type stun gun dropped TASER X1 (police model, scope rule). Sword cane's placeholder model 'Sword cane' removed. No new models.
